title: Bat-Winged Dinosaur Discovered
content: A bizarre new species of bat-winged dinosaur from China was announced yesterday inNaturemagazine.The nameYi qi, (pronounced "ee chee") means "strange wing." The fossil, presented by by Xu Xing, et al., shows evidence of elongated rod-like bones extending from the wrist which would have supported membranous wings.(Link to video) Although the pigeon-sized animal also had a feathery body coating, the feathers functioned more to regulate body heat, like the fur of a flying squirrel or bat. Whether this Jurassic maniraptoran theropod used its wings to flap or just to glide is still unclear.-----Nature: "A bizarre Jurassic maniraptoran theropod with preserved evidence of membranous wings"
